title: Possible a Sentry DSN with inline credentials assigned to SENTRY_DSN in source
description: The file contains a Sentry DSN with inline credentials assigned to SENTRY_DSN. The URL carries a user name and password in its authority section, so every reader, log line and backup that touches the file inherits the account. Shape-only: the match does not prove the endpoint is reachable.
remediation: Rotate the account in the connection string, then supply the URL from the environment or a secret manager so the password never lands in the repository.
limitation: Shape-only: a URL-shaped literal with a user:password authority carrying 6+ password characters. It cannot prove the endpoint is reachable or the account is live.
